payload.title: LimitedCounter: design a class

parts.label: a
parts.prompt:
Write the complete LimitedCounter class, including the constructor and any required instance variables and methods. A LimitedCounter accepts increments until a limit that is given to the constructor is reached. increment adds one to the counter and returns true if the limit has not been reached, and returns false (without changing the counter) otherwise. reset sets the counter back to its starting value. remaining returns the number of increments still allowed. Examples of the behavior are listed in the following table.

| Statement | Result |
|---|---|
| LimitedCounter c = new LimitedCounter(5); | creates a counter that accepts at most 5 increments |
| c.increment() (called 5 times) | true each time |
| c.increment() | false (the limit has been reached) |
| c.remaining() | 0 |
| c.reset(); c.remaining() | 5 |

increment returns true when accepted and false when refused (return type boolean)
reset restores the starting state (void method)
